Our core operations involve sourcing toys from reputable manufacturers and maintaining strong relationships with vetted suppliers to ensure product safety and compliance with all relevant CPSC safety regulations. We manage our inventory with rigorous stock audits and documentation, effectively preventing losses and maintaining operational efficiency. To prioritize the safety of our customers and employees, we have implemented comprehensive safety training programs covering product handling and customer interactions. Despite our commitment to providing a safe shopping environment, we currently lack documented cybersecurity measures, such as firewalls and data encryption, which are crucial for protecting sensitive customer and transaction data. As such, we are taking steps to enhance our cybersecurity protocols to better safeguard our operations and customer information.

Our toy store operates without any documented cybersecurity measures, such as firewalls or data encryption, as we focus primarily on providing a fun shopping experience for our customers.
